paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
notes: Paper constrains ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (and g_aBB hypercharge) in MeV-90 GeV range using LEP Z->2gamma/3gamma data, with LHC/FCC-ee projections. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However, no numerical exclusion table is provided; limits are shown only graphically in Fig. 4 (log10 g vs log10 ma plots) with no readable numbers. Table 1 only gives signal/background cross sections for a fixed assumed coupling (10^-4 GeV^-1), not exclusion limits. Therefore no reliable (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted. | Vision: Figure 4(a) shows the new LEP exclusion (green) from Z->2gamma (dashed) and Z->3gamma (solid) in the MeV-90 GeV ALP mass range (log10 m_a/eV ~ 6 to ~11). The plot is a compilation overlay; the green LEP region's lower boundary is approximate due to overlapping shaded regions (SN1987a, beam dump). Coupling is g_agamma in GeV^-1. The new LEP boundary roughly spans g_agamma ~ 4e-4 at MeV masses down to ~3e-5 near the Z mass. Axes are log10 scale.
